title: Canonical affine coherent comparison and structural pullback
statement: Let f:X→S be quasi-compact and separated, G quasi-coherent, V,V′ affine etale over S and h:V′→V. Put b=affineRealizationChartMap f h:V′×_S X→V×_S X and psi=affineRealizationCoefficientMap f G h, the constructed induced map and tensor-composition coefficient morphism [def-weil-pbc-affine-pullback-coefficient-map]. Use HasQcoherentPullbackSectionFormula to retain exactly the universal section equation, and coherentEtalePullbackMap for exactly cohomologyMap followed by the adjunct coefficient H.map [def-weil-pbc-coherent-etale-pullback-data]. There exists theta from the lifted tensor pullback coefficient on V×_S X to b_* of the coefficient on V′×_S X, with section formula qcoherentPullbackSection for tensorSectionsComp followed by b.w [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-pullback-sections-map]. For every Ext cohomology class x, apply cohomologyMap(b), then H.map of the adjoint of theta, then affineRealizationAffineComparison at V′. The result equals affineRealizationRestriction of affineRealizationAffineComparison at V applied to x [def-weil-pbc-affine-cohomology-comparison-data]. This is the ordinary-cohomology square, with no raw derived-Hom class or raw evaluation.

proof.text: The base changes of f over the affine charts are compact and separated. Use affineNormalizedComparisonFamily on these two actual fibre-product schemes. Its normalization theorem supplies the hypotheses of qcoherentNormalizedComparison_pullback_square. Apply the normalized square with affineRealizationChartMap and affineRealizationCoefficientMap. The private generic transport lemma specializes its all-degrees conclusion to q and composes pointwise comparison and restriction equalities. Identify each affineRealizationAffineComparison first with affineRealizationComparison by the existing affine specialization equation, and then with the inverse named family. Identify the ordinary map by affineRealizationRestriction_apply. These equalities produce the required section formula and cohomology square. The named constructions are exactly the original base-change arrow, normalized tensor composition, equality transport and uniquely normalized comparison; no hypothesis or conclusion changes. Empty schemes, zero modules, identities and q=0 remain covered. The proposition structure stores exactly the full section formula. Its constructor and the pullback-map evaluation equation turn the generic square into the named statement without changing any section or cohomology class.

lean.statement:
theorem affineRealizationComparison_pullback {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (G : X.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (q : ℕ) (V V' : S.Etale) [IsAffine V.left] [IsAffine V'.left] (h : V' ⟶ V) :
    ∃ θ : liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V) ⟶
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (affineRealizationChartMap f h)).obj
        (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V')),
      HasQcoherentPullbackSectionFormula (affineRealizationChartMap f h)
        (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V) (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V')
        (affineRealizationCoefficientMap f G h) θ ∧
      ∀ x : Sheaf.H (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V)) q,
        affineRealizationAffineComparison f G q V'
          (coherentEtalePullbackMap (affineRealizationChartMap f h)
            (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V) (affineRealizationCoefficient f G V') θ q x) =
          affineRealizationRestriction f G q h
            (affineRealizationAffineComparison f G q V x)

old_proof.text:
Put Y=V times_S X and Y'=V' times_S X, with induced etale map b.
Base change of quasi-compactness makes Y and Y' compact over the affine charts.
Separatedness over an affine scheme gives absolute separatedness of each.
Let c and c' be the uniquely normalized comparison families chosen in
exists_unique_qcoherentNormalizedComparison. The definitions of
affineRealizationComparison and affineRealizationAffineComparison use exactly
these families. Take psi to be tensorSectionsComp(b,pullback.snd) followed by
the transport along b.w. Apply qcoherentNormalizedComparison_pullback_square
to c,c', their normalization properties, and psi. It supplies theta and exactly
the section formula in the statement. Its equation holds for every Ext class x.
Rewrite the affine comparisons using affineRealizationAffineComparison_eq;
unfold affineRealizationComparison to identify them with c.symm and c'.symm.
Unfold affineRealizationRestriction: its chosen tensor adjunction and psi are
precisely those in the ordinary map of the square. Substitute these equalities.
No raw comparison or Ext-to-derived evaluation is used. Empty charts, zero
coefficients and degree zero are covered by the same equations.
